goal: Move each UOR Foundation repository's remediation from its observed change set to conformance only through an owner's approval, a reviewed pull request, the owner's settings and a fresh observation.

app.name: uor-remediation-lifecycle
app.title: Remediation lifecycle
app.purpose: Give the next step of a repository's remediation from its step now, the Organization Owner's approval, its pull request, the settings only the owner applies, and what the decision apps find on a fresh observation.

fields.name: step
fields.means: the remediation's step now: observed (change set projected), approved, opened (pull request open), merged, applied (settings applied), conformant, or declined

fields.name: approval
fields.means: whether an Organization Owner approved the remediation

fields.name: pr
fields.means: the remediation pull request: not opened, open, merged, or closed without merging

fields.name: settings
fields.means: whether the owner applied the topics, rulesets and renames of the change set

fields.name: outcome
fields.means: what the repo decision apps find on a fresh observation: not yet observed, a norm still unmet, or conformant

meanings.observed: the change set is projected from an observation and waits for approval
meanings.approved: an Organization Owner approved the change set
meanings.opened: the remediation pull request is open for review
meanings.merged: a maintainer merged the remediation pull request
meanings.applied: the owner applied the settings the change set names
meanings.conformant: a fresh observation finds every decision app conformant
meanings.declined: a maintainer closed the pull request without merging; the remediation ends and the open claims stay

rules.why: a declined remediation is final; its open claims stay in the register

app.otherwiseWhy: an observed change set waits for an Organization Owner's approval

properties.why: no pull request is opened without approval
conformance is found only after the settings are applied and the repository observed again

stakeholders.name: Organization Owner
stakeholders.text: Approves each remediation and applies its settings, and needs to see which step every repository is at.

stakeholders.name: Repository Maintainer
stakeholders.text: Reviews and merges or declines the remediation pull request, and needs a declined remediation to end rather than be reopened.

stakeholders.name: Agent contributor
stakeholders.text: Opens the pull requests and re-observes the repositories, and needs each step to name the act that moves it.

stakeholders.name: Community and Outreach Committee
stakeholders.text: Reports the ecosystem's standards health and needs a repository counted conformant only on a fresh observation.

components.name: GitHub repository settings
components.text: The topics, rulesets, names and files of each UOR-Foundation repository.

components.name: Remediation register
components.text: remediation/project.mjs and remediation/register.json in UOR-Foundation/community, which project each repository's change set from the decision apps.

components.name: Ecosystem register
components.text: ecosystem/snapshot.mjs and remediation/observe.mjs, which observe the repositories again after the change.

threats.name: Conformance claimed on the plan
threats.text: A repository is reported conformant because its pull request merged, before any observation.

control.name: Observed conformance only
control.text: Only a fresh observation moves a remediation to conformant.

threats.name: Pull request without approval
threats.text: A remediation pull request is opened before the owner approves it.

control.name: Approval first
control.text: An observed remediation moves only on approval.

quality.requirement: Every step moved by its act
quality.text: Each transition names the approval, pull request, settings or observation that moves it.
quality.measureText: Rules that change the step with no act in their condition.
